summary: First idea that NAEP scores haven't moved becuase teachers do not use "brain based research" total hogwash. Not sure where full court media press came on "brain based" but probably because they watered down "research based" needed something else to blame on teachers.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: First idea that NAEP scores haven't moved becuase teachers do not use "brain based research" total hogwash. Not sure where full court media press came on "brain based" but probably because they watered down "research based" needed something else to blame on teachers.
